findings.subject: Original 192-pixel preview is clipped
findings.evidence: The original 840 by 560 sheet places a 192 by 192 tile at x 600, y 410. Its tile rectangle ends at y 602, below the canvas. The observed PNG visibly cuts off the bottom of the device.
findings.consequence: The original sheet cannot establish a complete 192-pixel inspection. Its complete 64, 96, 128 and 512 views remain useful.
findings.requested_correction: Preserve the original and create a new sheet large enough to contain every sample, then inspect it.

findings.subject: Individual artwork creator is unconfirmed; the page does contain a personal author name
findings.evidence: Saved HTML line 13 has meta name=author content=Vedran. Artwork-specific ImageObject creator and SVG published by fields name publicdomainvectors.org. The downloaded SVG contains no creator metadata.
findings.consequence: Saying no individual name occurs on the source page is too broad. The page-level author tag does not establish that Vedran created this artwork.
findings.requested_correction: Retain publicdomainvectors.org as the credited organization and state no confirmed individual artwork creator. Preserve the original wording and add the clarification separately.

initial_decision: Promising for native caller comparison, with complete 192-pixel review and precise creator wording pending.
limits: These findings concern review evidence and provenance wording. They are not a failed recognition study or a rejection of the artwork's broad payment-device sense.
